definition: Broader candidate panel with recorded Gene Ontology and manual annotations. Figure 6 combines 41 genes from this 108-gene panel with 26 additional immune-interaction genes, giving 67 genes in 12 analysis groups. The timestamp identifies the supplied historical record; prospective registration is not established by that timestamp.
